description: Get the STANDARD published Wilderness Times checklist as a ready-made PDF — the full, unedited list, free and with no signup. Available for camping, backpacking, winter camping and day hiking. IMPORTANT: this is the standard list and does NOT reflect any customisation. If the user has added, removed or filtered items, call share_checklist instead — the link it returns opens their own list in the checklist builder, which exports to PDF, Excel, Google Sheets or print with the gear links intact.
name: get_checklist_pdf
title: Get a printable checklist PDF
